desc:
ALL SQUISHIES NOW SAVE EVEN ON THE FLOOR!

👍 THUMBS UP for more UPDATES and a FREE CODE at 50,000 LIKES 👍

🖥️ PC Controls:

E or Click - Pickup / Place squishy
F - Drop squishy
Numbers - Switch squishy
T - Unlock Mouse
G - Magic Ability
Hold Click - Squish

🎮 Controller Controls:

RT - Pickup / Place squishy
LT - Drop squishy
Upgrades - Y
Hold LT - Squish

🧸 Your local squishy shop has been turned upside down and the squishies are everywhere! Unlock your inner collector and help clean up the mess by sorting thousands of adorable squishies hidden around the entire shop!

👥 Cleanup alone or with friends!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Earn upgrades and abilities to help make the job easier!

✨ Inspired by cute cleanup and collecting games ✨
